name: services/crstests/participant
description: This method retrieves all the tests that concern a student.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

result_fields.name: tests
result_fields.description: A dictionary mapping from term IDs to list of dictionaries representing roots of tests, each of the following structure: The dictionary will contain primary fields from root_node method.

result_fields.name: terms
result_fields.description: A dictionary mapping from term IDs (the keys of tests field) to the results of the term method. Only primary keys will be present.
